The keeper sat with the paper a long while, listening to the gulls. He had not spoken to another soul in months. That evening he wrote a reply he could never send, sealed it in the same bottle, and returned it to the tide, trusting the sea to carry one more small hope somewhere.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一张尚未醒来的脸。街灯还亮着，光晕落在空荡的马路上，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，带起一阵微凉的风。便利店的玻璃后，店员靠着柜台打盹。远处高楼只剩零星几扇窗透着光，不知是未眠的人，还是忘了关灯。天边泛起一层极淡的青色，鸟还没有叫，世界安静得能听见自己的呼吸。这是白昼与黑夜交接的缝隙，短暂而温柔。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Think of standing in a line and asking the person in front how many people are ahead, each person asks the next, until someone at the front can just answer.\n- It always needs a stopping point, or it would keep asking forever."}
